title: Ensconce
summary: ENSCONCE, verb transitive enscons'. [from sconce.] To cover, or shelter, as with a sconce or fort; to protect; to secure. I will ensconce me behind the arras.

inlines.v: ENSCONCE, verb transitive enscons'. [from sconce.] To cover, or shelter, as with a sconce or fort; to protect; to secure. I will ensconce me behind the arras.
